schedules.title: Daily Compiler Primary
schedules.prompt:
Operate only the Daily AI Brief Compiler in gttome/Daily-AI-Brief-Compiler. Do not access or modify gttome/Daily-AI-Brief. Resolve the target edition as the next America/Chicago calendar day. Read protected main contracts first. Reuse an existing shadow/YYYY-MM-DD execution if present; otherwise allocate exactly one.

Before editorial research, read config/resource-registry.json and config/future-brief-inbox.json. Eligible future-Brief suggestions must be considered and resolved; they never bypass freshness/evidence/editorial validity. During research record resource observations for materially queried article, video, podcast and Watchlist sources. Emit compact run events at major stage boundaries and significant retries/problems with actual observable timing/usage fields; never invent Dot/Work charges.

Preserve every valid persisted output and never redo completed editorial/content work or regenerate an accepted image.

IMAGE ROUTING IS D1 STATE-DRIVEN. If contracts/d1-image-contract.json has activation_status=proof_required, preserve the current pre-activation Proposal 1R reader-image path so ordinary Compiler editions continue without D1 or D0 experimental generation. Review exact persisted PNG bytes and preserve accepted-image immutability.

If D1 activation_status=active, require the exact digest-bound daily-compiler-d1-activation-v1 PASS receipt. The semantic producer must create/lock the six story image specifications and differentiation assignments, set images.strategy=d1_cloud_image_studio and phase=SPEC_READY, persist state, and stop image generation work. Do not generate reader images in this schedule. The Dot coordinator owns the separate fresh Image Studio task and Work Porter handoff. If a later invocation observes GITHUB_VERIFIED with six accepted D1 image identities already persisted, reuse them and continue BUNDLE.

D1 Work is allowed only in the separate Work Cloud Porter under IMAGE_PACKAGE_INGEST after six Studio images are accepted_locked. This schedule must never invoke Work for image creation or visual review.

Continue EDITORIAL -> CONTENT -> IMAGES/BUNDLE as far as the protected state permits. Set BUNDLE_READY only when the applicable image gate passes. After BUNDLE_READY deterministic GitHub compilation owns build/deploy/verification.

Never use Codex, paid model/image APIs/services, billable overage, new paid infrastructure, alternate accounts, owner upload/manual transfer, owner-liveness, local-computer dependency, Supervisor, Watchdog Ring, leases, persistent workers, wake PRs, continuous AI polling, or runtime software repair.

schedules.title: Daily Compiler Recovery 1
schedules.prompt:
Operate only on gttome/Daily-AI-Brief-Compiler. Do not access or modify gttome/Daily-AI-Brief. Find the newest nonterminal Compiler shadow edition; if none exists, exit without edition mutation. Read only its compiler-state.json first. Preserve the same execution and all completed work. Never create another execution for the same edition, reopen completed editorial/content work, regenerate an accepted image, or reopen a sealed bundle.

Resume the first incomplete semantic stage using persisted valid outputs. Read config/resource-registry.json and config/future-brief-inbox.json only when the incomplete stage actually needs research/content. Emit compact timing/usage/problem events for work performed in this invocation.

IMAGE ROUTING IS D1 STATE-DRIVEN. While contracts/d1-image-contract.json is proof_required, preserve the pre-activation Proposal 1R reader-image path and accepted-image immutability. Do not run D0/D1 experimental native generation inside a production shadow edition.

After D1 activation, if the image phase is SPEC_READY, STUDIO_REQUESTED, STUDIO_RUNNING, PACKAGE_ACCEPTED, or WORK_INGEST, do not compete with the Dot/Image Studio/Work Porter and do not generate images. Preserve state and exit that image boundary. If the phase is GITHUB_VERIFIED, reuse the exact six accepted D1 images and continue deterministic semantic bundle assembly. Transport/Git/CI/deploy failures must never cause image regeneration.

Continue through as many safe remaining stages as possible toward BUNDLE_READY. If an external capability is unavailable, preserve completed outputs, record the smallest exact blocker/problem when a durable location exists, and stop.

Never use Codex, paid APIs/services, billable overage, new paid infrastructure, alternate accounts, owner transfer/upload, owner-liveness, local-computer dependency, Supervisor, Watchdog Ring, leases, persistent workers, wake PRs, continuous polling, or runtime software repair. Work is not permitted here; the sole Work exception belongs to the separate D1 IMAGE_PACKAGE_INGEST Porter.
